title: Blight at the Rift-Scar
description: Where the moor ends the ground is wrong — a scar in the world the old folk call the rift-echo, and the bloodthorn there has grown into horrors that no fire kills for long. Cut the blightthorn horrors back from the scar. Past them, the western sky-lane runs to Ashmoor, and to whatever waits beyond the wold.

objectives.desc: Cut back the blightthorn horrors at the rift-scar
